Name: DCB's Shie style Luo Portrait-They Stay With You
Author: DistilledChickenBurger
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=2]I am not a native English speaker and use an English translator. If there is any ambiguity, please feel free to post.[/size][/font]

[quote][b][size=5]﻿本模组的艺术风格来源于Shie，是一套非常优秀的肖像模组，多个知名模组都有联动。别忘了下载[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4264]Shie的肖像模组[/url]﻿。[/size]
[size=4]The artistic style of this mod comes from Shie, which is a very excellent portrait mod that is linked to multiple well-known mods. Please don't forget to download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4264]Shie's Portrait mod[/url]﻿.[/size][/b][/quote]

这是个仿照Shie风格的高清肖像，绘制角色是《[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30989]与你同在They Stay With You[/url]》中的“洛”。[b][size=5]必须使用[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]高清肖像模组[/url]才能启动[/size][/b]。
我非常喜爱Shie的画风，也有用户想要洛的高清肖像。我是初次上传这类肖像模组，不清楚肖像的上传需求，如果本模组有不合时宜或侵权的内容，我会删除。感谢大家的指正。

This is a portrait modeled after Shie's artistic style, depicting the character 'Luo' from '[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30989]They Stay With You[/url]'. [b][size=5]You must use the "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]" mod to start.[/size][/b]If there is any inappropriate content in this mod, I will delete it.


[b][color=#ff7700][size=6]2025/02/26 6:00pm：请务必下载新版本，旧版本图片处理有些问题！我高清肖像模组用得不多，不知道图片少了一段，正常应该是要保留一个透明头像区域的！！
Please make sure to download the new version, as there may be some issues with image processing in the old version.[/size][/color][/b]




[b][size=5]【文件内容】[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=2]洛的肖像[s]（320*320px PNG）[/s][b][color=#ff7700]（640*320px）[/color][/b][/size]
[*][size=2]一共有3张图片，可以根据喜欢的风格选择[/size]
[*][size=2]将你选择好的肖像名字改成“Luo”，然后放入名叫Portraiture的文件夹，再挪入“[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]”模组内[/size]
[*][b][color=#ea9999][size=2]如果不改图片的名字，Portraiture模组会无法识别[/size][/color][/b]
[/list]

[b][size=5]  [File Content][/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=2]Portrait of Luo [s](320 * 320px PNG)[/s][b][color=#ff7700]（640*320px）[/color][/b][/size]
[*][size=2]There are three pictures in total, you can choose according to your favorite style[/size]
[*][size=2]Change the name of your selected portrait to 'Luo', then place it in a folder called Portraiture', and move it into the '[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]' module[/size]
[*][b][color=#ea9999][size=2]Without changing the name of the image, the Portrait module will not recognize it.[/size][/color][/b]
[/list]



[list]
[*][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Luo7710]@Luo7710[/url]﻿ 前排艾特洛老师，其实“洛”这个角色就是洛老师的自设。
[/list]
[list]
[*]受限于像素图的画幅大小，所以模组肖像没有头饰，实际上在设定里是有额饰的，高清肖像的画幅更大，所以我进行了补充。但为了风格的统一性，所以我增加了黑边框头饰与无头饰的版本，大家可以自由选择。
[*]Due to the limited size of the pixel image, the module portrait does not have a headpiece. In fact, the character has a headpiece, and the high-definition portrait has a larger size, so I have added it. But for the sake of style consistency, I have added black border headpieces and versions without decorations, so everyone can freely choose.
[/list]
